title: Civic area orientation
description: Web-search prompt that explains one civic scope on the user's Civic Ladder (what is distinctive, what it controls, who decides, how to participate) and returns structured JSON.

variables.name: state_or_equivalent
variables.description: State or equivalent; rendered as `(none)` when missing.

variables.name: level_display
variables.description: Display name of the civic level.

variables.name: scope_identifiers
variables.description: Identifiers for this scope (rendered as JSON).

variables.name: ladder_members
variables.description: Civic areas that share this scope on the ladder.

surfaces: GET /api/civic-scope/:boundaryGroupId/orientation (Civic Ladder → civic area orientation dialog)

usage.notes: Sent to the OpenAI Responses API with web search. Variable names mirror the snake_case CivicAreaOrientationContext schema so the API context can be passed through unchanged.
